name: broadcast-call-webrtc-responsive-final
changes: Random customer calls ring every eligible online listener in the selected language pool; direct profile calls ring only the selected listener.
First listener acceptance wins atomically; all other ringing listeners are released immediately for the next customer.
Calling signaling is bound to the exact winning customer/listener browser sockets to avoid duplicate-tab WebRTC negotiations.
Listener microphone permission is acquired before accepting a broadcast call so a listener cannot win and immediately break the call.
WebRTC queues early ICE candidates, supports ICE restart/recovery, and tolerates short signaling reconnects instead of ending immediately.
Customer mobile bottom navigation uses icons only; root navigation is hidden on nested pages such as listener profiles.
Customer desktop listener profile opens as a responsive full inner page rather than a small popup.
Listener settings, followers and profile surfaces use the light page background instead of large plain white panels.
Listener desktop/tablet spacing and bottom navigation remain responsive while mobile behavior stays compact.
Temporary backup files and redundant local patch artifacts are excluded from the distributable ZIP.
notes: v8.9.19 is based on the full v8.9.18 project and contains the final call-routing/signaling and requested UI cleanup pass.
TURN_URL, TURN_USERNAME and TURN_CREDENTIAL are strongly recommended for reliable calls across restrictive NAT/mobile networks.
